name: gdrive
mount_caveat: ⚠️ The raw CloudStorage path will NOT mount into Cowork's bash sandbox. Create a short symlink (e.g. `ln -s "$HOME/Library/CloudStorage/GoogleDrive-<you>/My Drive" "$HOME/gDrive"`) and attach THAT as the workspace folder. Verified 2026-09-02.
offline_requirement: Set the folder to "Available offline" in Drive for Desktop. Streaming mode leaves placeholders that read as empty files.
delete_note: `trash_file` via the Google Drive connector removes what `rm` refuses.
hazards: Google Docs appear on the mount as ~170-byte .gdoc POINTERS, not content — invisible to grep, Obsidian and snapshots. Never store project content as a Doc.
Drive's plain-text preview auto-linkifies path-shaped text, so relative markdown links render as broken http:// URLs. Wikilinks are ugly there but inert.
The connector's read_file_content returns ESCAPED text, not raw bytes. Read through the mount instead.
sharing: Share the folder, or use a Shared drive (requires Google Workspace Business Standard or above).
